title: Quadratic lintegral inequalities pass to L^2 limits
statement: Let alpha be a measurable space with measures mu and nu, let E and F be normed additive commutative groups, and let c in [0,infinity) (c != infinity). Let a_j, a_0 : alpha -> E and b_j, b_0 : alpha -> F (j in N) be a.e.-strongly measurable (the a's for mu, the b's for nu). If int^- ||a_j - a_0||_e^2 dmu -> 0, int^- ||b_j - b_0||_e^2 dnu -> 0, and int^- ||a_j||_e^2 dmu <= c int^- ||b_j||_e^2 dnu for every j, then int^- ||a_0||_e^2 dmu <= c int^- ||b_0||_e^2 dnu (lintegrals in [0,infinity]; the types live in universe Type).
lean_statement: ∀ {α E F : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] (μ ν : Measure α) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (a : ℕ → α → E) (a₀ : α → E) (b : ℕ → α → F) (b₀ : α → F), c ≠ ∞ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (a j) μ) → AEStronglyMeasurable a₀ μ → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (b j) ν) → AEStronglyMeasurable b₀ ν → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖a j x - a₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x, ‖b j x - b₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, ∫⁻ x, ‖a j x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ c * ∫⁻ x, ‖b j x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂ν) → ∫⁻ x, ‖a₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ c * ∫⁻ x, ‖b₀ x‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂ν
